title: Operate the append-only prospective shadow cohort
goal: Run the frozen protocol prospectively on new public events and preserve every input, rejection, simulated fill, valuation and code/config identity until at least 200 independent signals and six months of untouched evidence exist or an earlier no-go terminates the experiment.

approval.note: User authorised autonomous repository implementation on 2026-08-06. Real orders, broker/wallet access, paid data purchases and capital deployment remain excluded.

acceptance.assertion: New observations append with immutable hashes; earlier decisions and outcomes cannot be silently edited or backfilled.
Capital discussion is blocked until at least 200 independent eligible signals and six calendar months of untouched prospective evidence.
Collection gaps, SEC blocks, stale quotes, missing FX and parser ambiguity remain visible as rejected or interrupted intervals.
Report normal, doubled-cost, one-day-delay and ten-best-trades-removed views.
Runtime produces reports and bounded notifications only, with no broker, wallet, order, leverage, short or capital operation.
Completion yields an evidence-bound no-go or independent-review request; thresholds alone do not authorize capital.
